provenance.network: MARNET maritime route network as shipped in searoute-py 1.6.0 (https://github.com/genthalili/searoute-py, PyPI 'searoute', licence Apache-2.0), descended from Eurostat SeaRoute (https://github.com/eurostat/searoute, EUPL-1.2)
provenance.not_for_routing: the package states it is for realistic-looking routes, not for mariners; used here only to replace straight chords by lane distances
provenance.package_note: the installed package metadata and LICENCE.txt say Apache-2.0 (since v1.3.0). The network's upstream licence is EUPL-1.2; distances derived from it are attributed here
provenance.pair_rule: shortest path between the network nodes nearest to the two places + port approach distance at both ends (great-circle, ports only)
provenance.restriction_reason: container services do not use the Arctic routes

status: SIDECAR to data/graph/graph.json (additive, opt-in; the sidecar never edits the graph file). Distances are MODELLED from a public maritime route network; they are lane distances, not routing advice.
